title: Convenience-Store Premium Tracker
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn merchant_type=convenience
| stats sum(amount) as spend, avg(unit_price) as avg_unit_price, count as buys by merchant
| sort - spend
description: Shows how much extra you pay for convenience-store habits compared with cheaper routine shopping.
value: Convenience often means paying a premium for planning failure, and that pattern is worth seeing clearly.
implementation: Tag merchant type and unit price for convenience buys in `index=personal`; summarize spend and average price by merchant.
visualization: Merchant table of convenience spend and average unit price.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how much extra convenience-store habits are really costing compared with better-planned shopping.
